---
title: "Keywords"
---

In the *Keywords* tab, keywords can be configured. This tab can only be
accessed by Data Stewards. Keywords are specified in a 3-tier hierarchy:
domains contain keyword groups, and keyword groups contain keywords.
A keyword domain can be assigned to [a domain in the Domains tab](domains.qmd).

To add new keywords:

1. In the *Keywords* tab, under "Section", click *Domains*
2. Then in the *Add domain* bar enter your domain name (e.g. "Groundwater"),
   and click *Add domain* to add it to the list
3. Then under "Section" click on *Keyword Groups*
4. Fill in a Dutch group name in Group name NL (e.g. "Grondwater software"),
   an English name in Group name EN, and select a "facility type"
   (e.g. Numerical modelling)
5. Click on the keyword group you just created under "Keyword Groups"
6. On the right-hand side, add individual keywords. Make sure to add both an
   English and a Dutch name for each keyword
